tuples.subject: penal_charges
tuples.quote: 257. A UCB shall adhere to the following instructions for charging penal charges in respect of all the fresh loans availed from April 1, 2024 onwards.

tuples.subject: penal_charges
tuples.special_circumstance: credit cards, external commercial borrowings, trade credits (rupee / foreign currency export credit), structured obligations covered under product specific directions, and other foreign currency loans
tuples.quote: However, these instructions shall not apply to credit cards, external commercial borrowings, trade credits (rupee / foreign currency export credit) and structured obligations which are covered under product specific directions, as also other foreign currency loans.
